title: Box Truck
body:
Box Truck is a medium truck with a rigid cargo box mounted on its chassis, used for local deliveries, removals, and trade work. Box trucks are the standard urban delivery vehicle, sized to city streets and loaded through a rear roller door.

Box trucks keep cities supplied, and their familiar shape is the backdrop of every high street delivery.

title: Semi-Trailer Truck
body:
Semi-Trailer Truck is a heavy truck made of a tractor unit and a detachable semi-trailer, carrying up to tens of tonnes on long-haul routes. Semi-trailer trucks move most overland freight in North America and Europe, and their drivers are a profession of their own.

The semi-trailer truck is the backbone of continental freight, and its rest stops, routes, and culture are a world unto themselves.

title: Dump Truck
body:
Dump Truck is a truck with an open bed that tips to unload gravel, soil, sand, or rubble on building sites and quarries. Dump trucks are built for rough ground and heavy loads, with reinforced beds and powerful hydraulics.

Dump trucks are the visible muscle of construction, moving the earth that every building and road begins with.

title: Fire Truck
body:
Fire Truck is a specialist truck carrying pumps, ladders, hoses, and rescue equipment to fires and emergencies. Fire trucks are built for speed and for work at the scene, with crews, water tanks, and aerial ladders that reach high floors.

Fire trucks are public-service vehicles in the fullest sense, and their design is governed by the work of saving lives and property.

title: Refrigerated Truck
body:
Refrigerated Truck is a truck with an insulated, temperature-controlled cargo body for food, medicine, and other perishables. Refrigerated trucks keep the cold chain unbroken from producer to shop, and they are essential to modern food distribution.

The refrigerated truck made fresh food national, letting produce travel thousands of kilometres without spoiling.

title: Flatbed Truck
body:
Flatbed Truck is a truck with an open flat cargo platform for machinery, timber, steel, and oversized loads that cannot fit in a box. Flatbed loads are secured with straps and chains, and the driver must judge weight, balance, and clearance on every trip.

Flatbed trucks carry the awkward loads that keep industry moving: the machines, beams, and pipes that other trucks cannot hold.

title: Tanker Truck
body:
Tanker Truck is a truck carrying a cylindrical tank for liquids such as fuel, milk, water, or chemicals. Tanker trucks are built with baffles against sloshing, with safety valves and grounding, and with strict rules for the liquids they carry.

Tanker trucks are the quiet carriers of everyday life, delivering fuel to stations, milk to dairies, and water to places that need it.

title: Tow Truck
body:
Tow Truck is a truck fitted with a winch, a boom, or a flatbed for recovering broken-down or crashed vehicles. Tow trucks work day and night on roads and motorways, and their operators are first responders for stranded drivers.

Tow trucks are the road's rescue service, and their flashing lights are a familiar sight to every driver who has ever broken down.
